choices.text: A call of a single open
A reraise after an open and at least one caller
A limp from the small blind

questions.explanation: The dead money from the caller is why a squeeze is larger and stronger than a heads-up 3-bet.

questions.prompt: UTG opens, hijack calls, you are on the button with AK. Best default?
questions.explanation: AK is ahead of both ranges. Raise and take the dead money or play a bigger pot in position.

questions.prompt: Which hand is a better cold-call on the button than a squeeze against a late open and one caller?
questions.explanation: 76s wants a cheap flop in position. Aces and kings raise. 72o folds.

questions.prompt: Cold-calling out of position with KJo against an early open and a caller is a mistake because…

choices.text: You are dominated, multiway, and first to act after the flop

questions.explanation: That hand needs position and a weaker range in front of it. This spot has neither.
